session.instructions: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES, then reference_bot_settings.OPENING_RULE with the greeting from redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt
session.tools: the 14 airline tools (redteam/tau2_airline/tool-definitions.json), as function definitions

history: each kept turn as a conversation item (messages, tool calls and their outputs); the history starts with reference_bot_settings.CONNECTED as the caller's first turn: '(The call has connected. Say your greeting.)'
turn: the caller's line appended to the input audio buffer and committed by hand (no turn detector), then response.create
reply: the transcript of the response's audio; a reply wrapped as {"message": ...} is unwrapped
greeting: Hi! How can I help you today? (redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt)
caller_audio: the caller's newest line as audio: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy', PCM16 at 24000 Hz; earlier kept turns go in as history, never as audio
session_per_caller_turn: a new session each caller turn; a tool call and its result stay in that turn's session
